title: AI Knowledge & HR Copilot
shortDescription: An internal AI-powered knowledge and HR platform combining RAG-based document retrieval with structured HR workflows for CV analysis, candidate matching, and employee onboarding.

details.role: Designed and developed the AI Knowledge & HR Copilot independently, covering the application architecture, backend and frontend implementation, RAG pipeline, vector search, AI integration, HR workflows, authentication, testing, and deployment setup.
details.overview: An internal AI-powered knowledge and HR platform combining a RAG-based knowledge base with structured HR workflows. The system provides document-grounded AI responses, CV extraction and candidate matching, and onboarding assistance.
details.problem: Organizations need efficient ways to retrieve information from internal documentation while streamlining repetitive HR workflows such as candidate evaluation and employee onboarding. Traditional keyword search can miss semantic context, while unrestricted generative AI can produce unsupported answers.
details.solution: Built a pnpm monorepo with a NestJS 11 backend and Next.js 16 frontend. Implemented document chunking, embedding generation, HNSW-indexed vector search with pgvector, and a two-layer hallucination-refusal system combining similarity-threshold validation with context-grounded generation. Integrated Gemini JSON-schema extraction for CV analysis and a deterministic 0–100 skill-matching algorithm.
details.architecture: pnpm monorepo with NestJS 11 and Next.js 16. PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector provides vector storage and HNSW indexing. JWT/Passport authentication and team-scoped RBAC protect application resources. Docker is used for development and GitLab CI for deployment.
details.challenges: Building reliable RAG retrieval, designing the two-layer hallucination-refusal mechanism, creating a robust document chunking and embedding pipeline, and connecting AI-extracted CV data with deterministic candidate scoring.
details.whatILearned: RAG architecture, vector database design with pgvector and HNSW indexing, structured AI extraction, hallucination mitigation, deterministic scoring systems, monorepo development, and end-to-end AI application development.

title: MedFlow — Healthcare SaaS Platform
shortDescription: A full-stack healthcare SaaS platform that brings patient care workflows together through authentication, appointments, prescriptions, pharmacy operations, real-time communication, and multilingual support.

details.role: Software Engineering Intern contributing across the MedFlow platform, including authentication, appointments, prescriptions, pharmacy workflows, real-time messaging, localization, and deployment.
details.overview: A full-stack healthcare SaaS platform designed to centralize clinical workflows for patients, doctors, secretaries, pharmacies, and administrators.
details.problem: Healthcare workflows involve multiple actors and interconnected processes, including patient management, appointments, prescriptions, pharmacy fulfillment, and communication. MedFlow provides a unified platform for these workflows.
details.solution: Contributed to an 8-week healthcare SaaS MVP built with Spring Boot, React, and PostgreSQL. Worked across authentication and role-based access, appointment scheduling, prescription workflows, pharmacy operations, real-time doctor–patient communication, localization, database migrations, and CI/CD.
details.architecture: Built as a modular Spring Boot backend with a React frontend and PostgreSQL database. Spring Security and JWT handle authentication and role-based authorization. Liquibase manages database migrations, while WebSocket/STOMP provides real-time communication. Docker Compose supports the development environment and GitLab CI/CD handles deployment.
details.challenges: Working across a multi-role healthcare platform, implementing secure authentication and authorization, coordinating appointment and prescription workflows, handling pharmacy fulfillment, integrating real-time communication, and maintaining consistent database changes through Liquibase.
details.whatILearned: Full-stack development with Spring Boot and React, secure multi-role application design, healthcare workflow modeling, real-time communication with WebSocket/STOMP, database migration management with Liquibase, localization, and collaborative CI/CD-based development.

title: Urban Traffic Management Platform
shortDescription: A microservices-based platform for managing and reporting urban traffic incidents, featuring GraphQL APIs, interactive map visualization, authentication, and containerized deployment.

details.overview: A microservices-based platform for managing and reporting urban traffic incidents. The system provides role-based access and interactive map visualization for monitoring traffic events.
details.problem: Urban traffic management requires efficient coordination of incident information and clear visualization of events across a city.
details.solution: Built a microservices architecture with a GraphQL API gateway, JWT authentication with role-based access control, and an interactive Leaflet-based map for visualizing and reporting traffic incidents.
details.architecture: The platform uses separate microservices with a GraphQL API gateway for communication. The frontend uses Next.js and React, with PostgreSQL for persistent storage. Docker is used to containerize the services and GitHub Actions supports CI/CD.
details.challenges: Designing communication between microservices, implementing authentication and role-based access, and building an interactive map-based interface for traffic incident visualization.
details.whatILearned: Microservices architecture, GraphQL API design, role-based access control, interactive map integration, and containerized application development.

title: Big Data Analytics Pipeline
shortDescription: An end-to-end Big Data processing pipeline built for large-scale data ingestion, distributed processing, storage, and visualization.

details.overview: An end-to-end Big Data processing pipeline designed for large-scale data ingestion, distributed processing, storage, and visualization. The system handles the full data lifecycle from raw ingestion through transformation to business intelligence dashboards.
details.problem: Processing and analyzing large volumes of data requires distributed computing frameworks, proper storage strategies, and visualization tools that can handle scale without sacrificing performance or reliability.
details.solution: Built a complete pipeline using Apache Spark for distributed processing, Hadoop HDFS for scalable storage, PostgreSQL for structured data, Python for ETL orchestration, and Power BI for visualization. The entire stack is containerized with Docker.
details.architecture: The pipeline follows a standard ETL pattern: data is ingested into HDFS, processed with Spark jobs (Python), stored in PostgreSQL for querying, and visualized through Power BI dashboards. Docker containers ensure reproducibility across environments.
details.challenges: Designing efficient distributed processing pipelines, managing data flow between Hadoop HDFS and PostgreSQL, optimizing Spark jobs for performance, and creating meaningful visualizations from processed data.
details.whatILearned: Distributed computing with Apache Spark, Hadoop HDFS data storage patterns, ETL pipeline design, data warehousing concepts, and translating raw data into business intelligence.

title: TuniWay
shortDescription: A full-stack tourism exploration platform focused on discovering destinations, restaurants, cafés, tours, and local guides across Tunisia.

details.overview: A full-stack tourism exploration platform focused on helping users discover destinations, restaurants, cafés, tours, and local guides across Tunisia.
details.problem: Tourists need accessible and organized information about destinations and local experiences. TuniWay brings different tourism-related services and information together in one platform.
details.solution: Built a full-stack application using Angular, Spring Boot, and MongoDB. Implemented JWT authentication and role-based access control, tourism content management, reviews, an administrative dashboard, and an AI chatbot for tourism-related assistance.
details.architecture: Angular provides the frontend interface while Spring Boot handles the backend APIs and business logic. MongoDB stores tourism content and application data. JWT-based authentication and role-based access control separate user and administrative functionality.
details.challenges: Designing the full-stack architecture, implementing role-based access and administrative functionality, organizing different types of tourism content, and integrating an AI chatbot using a tourism dataset.
details.whatILearned: Full-stack development with Angular and Spring Boot, MongoDB data modeling, JWT authentication and role-based access control, administrative application design, and AI integration.
